content.comment_body: Hi, apologies for my English—I have an issue and don't understand what's wrong. When I try to download my [product_name] project, I get: "Download failed! SD Card file system is not found." However, I am using the correct SD card. My [product_name] ends with "0," so it should be compatible with this program. Any help is appreciated! [user_name]

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. What size is your microSD card? How is it formatted? It needs to be FAT32 with a maximum size of 32GB. What do the card diagnostics show? Are the card slot pins straight and undamaged?

Hello! Thanks for your reply. My SD card is formatted in FAT32 and has 8GB of capacity. Since my computer recognizes the SD card, should the program be able to download to it? Even so, I keep seeing the same error message.
What does the diagnostic tool for [product_name] say? Try: Main menu > Diagnostic > Hardware > SD card.

Great, it's working now—thank you! I can now view my project drawing on a web page as needed. Here’s a summary of my project: I built a miniature elevator for three floors. Each floor uses an infrared sensor to stop the elevator (sensor 0, sensor 1, sensor 2). There's a control box with buttons for each floor (floor 0, floor 1, floor 2). On my [product_name], I have 6 inputs and 2 outputs: I2 for sensor 0, I3 for sensor 1, I4 for sensor 2, I5 for button 0, I6 for button 1, I7 for button 2, Q1 to move down, Q2 to move up. When I use the control box, the web display accurately shows which button was pressed and which sensor is detected. The visualization is working perfectly. Thanks again!

analysis.insight_summary: The user had difficulty downloading a project to their [product_name] device due to an SD card file system issue. The troubleshooting focused on SD card formatting, size, and hardware diagnostics. After following recommendations including SD card checks and diagnostics, the user resolved the issue and successfully accessed their project online. The discussion highlights some uncertainty around error interpretation and troubleshooting procedures, but ultimately user satisfaction after receiving help.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple and reliable process for downloading projects to their [product_name] device with the SD card. They look for clear, actionable diagnostics and guidance when encountering any errors.
